prompt: /memorygame Using only the attached chapter, create an interactive memory game with three concept-definition pairs: training, inference and context. Include card flipping, match feedback and progress. Answer in English.

phases.name: generation

actions.label: Flip the first card and read its concept or definition.
Flip a second card and inspect the match feedback.
Turn the unmatched cards back over and continue.
